verdict.rationale: The pack documents ASC606 revenue recognition, accrued-revenue tracking and forecasting, and daily data exports. None of it documents in-product MRR, churn, cohort retention, or LTV analytics. Revenue recognition belongs to a different story, and warehouse exports are exactly the bolted-on BI path the story rejects, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, I get MRR, churn, cohort retention, and LTV analytics computed from the billing source of truth, not a bolted-on BI export
